dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, smooth narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle visible at the bottom of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no visible bulges or indentations along the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mid-to-light grey skin tone consistently visible across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches distributed unevenly across the dorsal surface, more apparent on the lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and the darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A faint, light-colored linear mark is visible on the left lateral side of the posterior dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A short, vertical linear scar or mark is visible on the left side of the central axis in the lower third of the visible body.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced raised linear dorsal ridge extending along the central longitudinal axis.
